deviations.what: qwen 0.23.3 sends session/request_permission in 'default' ACP mode (and once in 'plan' for read_file); the spec/brief said default mode executes with NO request_permission. AcpAgent answers it via nvsh approve either way; c53 (plan by default, approval='harness' opts into default) stands, and 'harness' mode is now also nvsh-mediated at the wire
deviations.reason: t12's live probe contradicted the 2026-09-14 scope probe; behaviour is safer than assumed, no code change needed beyond what t12 shipped

deviations.what: t6's @target grammar table rows live in tests/test_triggers_prose.py (where the existing @name mark tests already are) instead of tests/test_triggers.py, which is the decide() rule table only
deviations.reason: keeps test_triggers.py single-purpose; same coverage, different file than the acceptance text named

deviations.what: the no-ACP qwen fallback (t13's stream-json print-mode QwenAgent) is selected explicitly by the operator as backend 'qwen-p' (alias default = 'qwen-p' or @qwen-p/model) rather than auto-picked by the registry when 'the ACP path is disabled'; it runs read-only (tool_calling=False, --approval-mode plan)
deviations.reason: no task defined a disable-ACP switch; an explicit backend name needs no new config key and keeps 'qwen' = ACP unambiguous

deviations.what: for codex (app-server) and the qwen print-mode fallback, [agents.X] approval='harness' only changes what capabilities() reports: codex app-server has no approval UI of its own (the client is the UI) so nvsh mediates via requestApproval regardless; print-mode qwen has no approval channel at all
deviations.reason: reported by t11 and t13; the approval knob is meaningful only for harnesses with their own approval UI (qwen --acp, kiro)

deviations.what: t16 adds the shared close() escalation helper (wait -> terminate -> kill) to nvsh/agent/_subprocess.py and routes pi/acp/codex/agy/claude close() through it, touching those adapter files minimally
deviations.reason: the brief says 'import the shared escalation helper from _subprocess.py' but no such helper exists after wave 2; each wave-2 adapter shipped its own copy

deviations.what: t7's bash/python sync test imports the @target table from tests/test_triggers_prose.py (where d2 put it) instead of tests/test_slash.py, which holds no grammar table
deviations.reason: consequence of d2; tests/test_slash.py only tables the palette ordering

deviations.what: doctor detects auth state only for kiro (kiro-cli whoami); claude, codex, qwen and agy report auth 'not verified' because their only auth signal comes from a real print-mode invocation that would be a model call; login-command remediation for those four is a generic '<binary> login' guess and the kiro trust file path is unconfirmed
deviations.reason: the spec asks for auth detection without a model or network call; no such probe exists for those four CLIs (verified against their --help/--version output)

deviations.what: AcpAgent's stderr drain races an instant launch failure (~1 in 10 runs the ERROR says 'no stderr'); conformance pins qwen/kiro as STDERR_TAIL_RACE and accepts the exit status alone for them
deviations.reason: measured by t15 over 37 repeats; agy.py waits a beat for the drain, acp.py does not; adapters were out of t15's scope

deviations.what: ACP effort is not passed verbatim: AcpAgent sends session/set_config_option only when the operator's effort matches an option the harness advertised, else silently sends nothing while capabilities().effort stays True (tension with decision c24)
deviations.reason: t12 chose to filter rather than send a value the harness would reject; the conformance effort case for qwen-acp therefore proves only that the bytes sent are unedited

deviations.what: for stream-json harnesses (claude, agy, qwen-p) the daemon reuses the adapter and its session (--resume <session-id>) across consecutive failures, not one OS process: those CLIs end the process per turn by design; ACP keeps one child (measured); app-server keeps one rpc process (adapter-level tests only)
deviations.reason: acceptance text said 'reuse one warm process for stream-json/ACP/app-server'; the print-mode CLIs cannot hold one process across turns

deviations.what: 'nvsh agent list --json' shows eight adapters with paths (pi, qwen, qwen-p, claude, codex, agy, kiro, openai-compat), not six: qwen-p (print-mode fallback, d3) and the pre-existing openai-compat are listed too
deviations.reason: the count in the acceptance text predates d3; every entry carries its path and hosted flag, verified live on spark, thor and orin 2026-09-14
